title: Fist
overview:
The audition to decide the strongest idol of all time is on!!

Fist is a 3D fighting game in which hopeful idols battle their way through an audition decided with fists. Choose from contenders Marin Aoki, Mei, Ai Momoyama, Tokikaze, Maria Christel and Masami Dotsuki, and face rivals including male brawlers in one-on-one bouts.

- Heroines voiced by Kyoko Hikami, Mariko Kohda, Ikue Ohtani, Atsuko Tanaka, Kikuko Inoue and Akemi Okamura
- Voice actress gallery screen
- 1 or 2 players

史上最強アイドル決定オーディション開催!!
